Overview

Szolnok is a city in Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok with a population of 70,554. A city on the Great Plain at the confluence of the Tisza and Zagyva rivers, known for its thermal baths, aviation museum, and the Szolnok Castle. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
